title: knowledge_source tombstones: say what a code-door (registerSource) author does, and that an underscore-led 18 id keeps its old index key
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4BAjgQ43tqy1DvVJ

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37304 (PR #37676, contract record 7206413701 nit N5, seat REWORK 7206423476), filed by the owning zone ai-37000 under #37304 at the seat's direction, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards. Handed to repo:objectstack#1 with the #37000 ledger (7206523866).
Grading: area:ai · domain:spec · Task · p3 (seat-directed) · reach: authors upgrading a code-registered knowledge source from 18 · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：旧写法的报错提示让作者去跑迁移命令，但在代码里注册的知识源没东西可迁；提示要改成告诉他们直接改代码，并说明旧 id 带下划线的源改名后会留下旧索引。
- 谁受益：升级的开发者照提示就能改对。
- 不做会怎样：提示指向一个没用的命令；功能不受影响。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

Each retired-key tombstone for `knowledge_source` ends by sending the author to `os migrate meta --from 18`. The only 18 instance is a registration in code (`registerSource`), which that command cannot walk. The ADR-0087 D3 entry says the compiler and the parse carry it; the tombstone does not. The entry also does not say that a source whose 18 `id` began with an underscore keeps an index under the old key once it is renamed.

## Acceptance

- The tombstone text names the code-door fix (edit the registration) beside the migrate command, and the D3 entry states the underscore-led id's stale index and how it is dropped (rebuild / `dropSource`).
- Pins on the tombstone text updated; no shape change.
